name: doze1_loop
note: Dozing off, 14-frame seamless loop @10FPS (1.4s; widget rate 0.7 -> 2s/cycle). Standing still, eyes droop and her head nods lower and lower until she nearly tips over, then she startles awake, rubs one eye, yawns and drifts back toward dozing. Body position stays fixed; only head, eyes and one arm move. NO floating 'Zzz' or symbols detached from the body (they get removed by the matte cleanup).
